item.title: Russian strikes across Ukraine kill at least 8 civilians and wound dozens
item.description: The attacks expanded Russia's near-daily bombardment of Ukrainian cities, as Moscow sought to exploit Kyiv's shortage of Western-supplied air defenses.

item.title: Digital habits that drain attention and energy — and how to fight them
item.description: NPR's Manoush Zomorodi explains why multi-screening makes you tired and offers science-based strategies to reclaim focus.

item.title: With no federal AI rules for schools, 98 teens created their own guidelines
item.description: A group of about 100 teenagers gathered to address questions on AI use in assignments, tests, and literacy education.
